issues.title: Turkey, Pakistan, Egypt, Saudi Arabia condemn Houthi attacks on Riyadh airport
issues.title_en: Turkey, Pakistan, Egypt, Saudi Arabia condemn Houthi attacks on Riyadh airport
issues.summary: ANKARA, Oct 12 (Reuters) - Turkey, Pakistan, Egypt and Saudi Arabia condemned attacks by Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi militants on Riyadh's international airport, saying they were a "dangerous escalation that cannot be justified or accepted under any pretext".One person was killed and nearly a dozen hurt in a new attack on Riyadh's international airport on Sunday, Saudi authorities reported, a day after a strike claimed by theHouthis that killed 13 people and wounded more than 300.
